result.detail:
Scope: rtl_source (axil_timer.v, entry axil_timer) and testbench (axil_timer_tb.v first, entry axil_timer_tb; axil_timer_tb_lane.v as the lane module).

All files carry `timescale 1ns/1ps`, so mixed-timescale errors (Verilator TIMESCALEMOD) do not arise. Each file also restores `default_nettype wire` at its end.

The testbench addresses through 32-bit task arguments truncated to ADDR_WIDTH, so the ADDR_WIDTH 4 lane builds without width truncation. The high-offset tests run only in the ADDR_WIDTH 8 lane.

Open item for the tech lead: the formal proof (axil_timer.sby and axil_timer_aw8.sby) required by the upstream specs is not delivered here. It should be scheduled as a follow-up, or added to this task in a later revision; a single formal_spec file per submission is allowed.

Independent review is still required: [evidence:prj-f38ca11b11.microarchitecture.e1] covers the upstream spec, not this RTL.
